meta.frameworkCorrection: The project was described as Nuxt, but the codebase is Next.js 16 (App Router) + React 19 + TypeScript 5.9 + Tailwind CSS 4.

npm run build -> PASS (Next.js 16.3.5, 19 static + dynamic routes)
CI workflow vs package.json scripts cross-check

gradeRationale.overall: Solid UI demo skeleton with a working build, but zero tests, demo-only auth, broken CI script, debug routes shipped, and most planned production features unfinished. Fair grade for a mid-stage student demo, not for delivery.
gradeRationale.client_usage: Can be shown as an interactive prototype after login with demo credentials, but the landing page forces login, the /demo link is broken, and forgot-password / offline / PDF features are stubs — a strict client review will notice.
gradeRationale.system: Cannot be operated as a real mandi system: no device auth for ESP32, in-memory DB fallback is the effective default, rate limiting is per-process, reset endpoint lacks handler-level auth, debug/test APIs are public.

secondOpinion_ollama.note: Ollama was stricter on client readiness (auth friction) and slightly more generous on system readiness. Primary auditor scores sit between the two views; final grades above are the reconciled strict assessment.

criticalIssues.title: CI runs npm test but no test script exists
criticalIssues.recommendation: Add vitest + a minimal test suite, or remove the CI step until tests exist.

criticalIssues.title: Debug/test API routes deployed in production build
criticalIssues.evidence: Build route list includes /api/debug/env and 6 /api/test-* routes
criticalIssues.recommendation: Delete or gate behind NODE_ENV!=='production' + admin auth.

criticalIssues.title: ESP32 cannot authenticate — middleware redirects API calls to HTML login
criticalIssues.evidence: middleware matcher ':path*' + no device API keys; firmware template posts to gate-verify
criticalIssues.recommendation: Exempt device endpoints with HMAC/device-key auth; never redirect API to HTML.

criticalIssues.title: TURSO_* env vars set but code reads DATABASE_URL — silently in-memory
criticalIssues.recommendation: Unify env contract; wire Prisma adapter with TURSO_AUTH_TOKEN; add smoke test for DB mode.

criticalIssues.title: Auth is file-based demo; SessionProvider missing; operator/admin land on missing routes
criticalIssues.evidence: data/users.json; no SessionProvider; login redirects to /dashboard and /admin which don't exist
criticalIssues.recommendation: Move users to DB, add SessionProvider, create /dashboard and /admin or redirect to existing pages.

criticalIssues.title: Landing page requires login; /demo link broken; / route double-defined
criticalIssues.evidence: middleware forces login on /; app/(demo)/page.tsx vs app/page.tsx; href='/demo'
criticalIssues.recommendation: Public / and /demo; rename route group to app/demo/page.tsx; allowlist public paths in middleware.

criticalIssues.title: /api/v1/reset has no handler-level authorization
criticalIssues.recommendation: Require admin token inside the handler (defense in depth).

criticalIssues.title: Prisma path bugs: unawaited createBooking, unawaited getSlotsForMandi, no-op reset
criticalIssues.recommendation: Await all db calls; implement real reset or remove endpoint.

criticalIssues.title: zod imported but not a direct dependency
criticalIssues.evidence: lib/validation/telemetry.ts imports zod; package.json has no zod entry (only transitive via @hookform/resolvers)
criticalIssues.recommendation: Add "zod" to dependencies and pin version.

criticalIssues.title: CSP allows unsafe-inline and unsafe-eval
criticalIssues.recommendation: Nonce-based CSP for production; drop unsafe-eval.

Delete or production-gate all /api/debug/* and /api/test-* routes; remove from build.
Declare zod in package.json; align DATABASE_URL vs TURSO_* env contract; await Prisma calls; implement or remove reset.
recommendations.impact: Prevents silent data-mode and API breakage

recommendations.action: Add Vitest unit tests for lib/spatial, lib/crypto, lib/validation, and API routes; replace CI npm test step with real runner; enforce lint/type/test/build gates.
recommendations.impact: Restores CI trust and regression safety

recommendations.action: Introduce device API-key or HMAC auth for telemetry endpoints; stop middleware redirecting API traffic to HTML.
Add SessionProvider, move users into Prisma User table, add /api/health, global-error.tsx, structured logs.
Either implement IndexedDB offline passes + PDF receipts or remove those claims from the UI before client review.
Implement distributed rate limiting, tighter CSP, and remove soft-fail on npm audit in CI.

finalVerdict.oneLiner: A visually strong mid-fidelity demo of a mandi queue + IoT weighbridge system that builds clean, but is not yet a testable, durable, or hardware-connectable system — and needs small demo-trust fixes before a strict client walkthrough.
readyFor: Internal demo / viva presentation with pre-shared credentials
Continuation as a student project base
notReadyFor: Client acceptance as a production system
Live pilot at a real mandi with ESP32 devices
Any deployment with public internet exposure without removing debug routes and fixing auth
